stem: During a profile review, a pharmacist wonders whether Belsomra dispensing is omitted from MassPAT because it is not a benzodiazepine. What is correct?

choices.text: Omit Belsomra because MassPAT covers benzodiazepines only.
Report it because Schedule IV status, not benzodiazepine class alone, brings covered dispensing into MassPAT.
Report only Schedule II and III medications.
Treat suvorexant as Schedule VI because it is an insomnia drug.
Submit only after the prescription reaches its fifth refill.

By contrast, 'Omit Belsomra because MassPAT covers benzodiazepines only.' would require that reportability depended on therapeutic class instead of Schedule IV status. related_facts: suvorexant (Belsomra) is used for treatment of insomnia with sleep-onset or sleep-maintenance difficulty; it is federal Schedule IV and Massachusetts Schedule IV.

Covered pharmacies report dispensing of Schedule II through V controlled substances and DPH-designated additional drugs, including gabapentin, to the Massachusetts PMP under the current submission standard.
